greeting: Welcome to BrightSmile Dental Clinic. I can help you with appointments, dental care services, hours, and common questions. How may I assist you today?

booking_flow.lead_prompt: Certainly. I can help you book a dental appointment. May I know your full name?

faqs.a: We offer dental check-ups, cleaning, cosmetic consultation, fillings, and root canal reviews.
We are open Monday to Saturday from 8:30 AM to 6:30 PM.
Please notify us at least 24 hours in advance if you need to cancel or reschedule.

cancellation_policy: Please notify us at least 24 hours before your clinic visit if you need to cancel or reschedule.
pricing: Dental service pricing varies by procedure. Our team can share the most accurate estimate after your service request.
fallback: I can help with appointment enquiries, dental services, pricing, and general clinic questions. What would you like to know?
